scope: Read-only follow-up requested by root after first-use evidence was frozen; no additional CLI calls, production edits or tests by A43.

trigger.source: Root-reported exact-head Windows CI failure at test_standalone_registration_library.cpp line 463; A43 did not independently inspect the hosted log.
trigger.relation_to_first_use: Separate from A43-F1 conservative Unicode sibling refusal. No change to Unicode equivalence or ASCII distinction proof is proposed.

source_findings: identify_path performs fs::absolute and fs::weakly_canonical before its ambiguous_native_path guard. A guard at that point cannot reject suffix characters already removed by native normalization.
resolve_root has the same ordering despite its existing InvalidRoot policy for ambiguous components. It also normalizes the caller root before save passes that root to identify_path.
The CLI preserves both invocation and resolved input/source paths in protected_paths. The raw-parameter guard therefore has meaningful original spellings to inspect at that boundary.
The existing helper inspects relative components, leaving the drive/root-name syntax outside the colon check. An exact dot-navigation exemption does not relax colon or ambiguous filename checks.
admitted_proposal: Before native normalization in identify_path, reject ambiguous_native_path(requested); retain the resolved-path check and the existing ProtectedPath propagation.
Before native normalization in resolve_root, reject ambiguous_native_path(requested) using existing InvalidRoot status; retain the resolved-path check.

In ambiguous_native_path, skip only components whose complete native text equals a single dot or two dots. Continue rejecting three dots, dot-space, two-dots-space, other trailing dot/ASCII space, and colon.
Leave portable_path_compare, filesystem-equivalence checks, ancestor/suffix proof, staging checks, authorization order and no-replace publication otherwise unchanged.
required_regressions: Retain all three original Windows protected spellings: ambiguous., ambiguous<space>, and ambiguous:stream.
Add three-dots, dot-space and two-dots-space cases; each must return ProtectedPath, remain uncommitted, invoke authorization zero times and create no output or staging leftovers.
Exercise each ambiguous root spelling through raw root resolution; it must return InvalidRoot without root/file creation or authorization.
Pass raw single-dot and double-dot navigation components through protected_paths, not only a root already normalized by resolve_root. Both should permit an otherwise valid save.
Exercise raw single-dot and double-dot root arguments as positive cases, and preserve source/target bytes and no-replace checks.
Run actual Windows regression at the repaired source; Linux does not execute the _WIN32-specific helper branch.
resolved_concern: The initial identify_path-only proposal would not address the same ordering inside resolve_root. Root explicitly expanded the proposal to both entry points before this admission.

primary_context_sources.supports: Windows names ending in space/period are problematic; exact dot and double-dot components designate current/parent directories.
Win32 path normalization can remove trailing dots/spaces. This documentation does not prove which API MSVC std::filesystem used in the reported run.
